title: Introduce subnet shadowing and staged Privatelink switchover operator
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Motivation: Private control plane migrations to new PrivateLink endpoints often require careful, per-AZ cutovers to avoid control plane disruptions. Existing tooling performs route table swaps in-place which can cause transient connection loss for the control plane and user workloads. This PR introduces a subnet-shadowing pattern and a staged Privatelink switchover operator to enable non-destructive endpoint adoption with safe rollbacks.

Summary of changes: added Terraform modules to create 'shadow' subnets that mirror control-plane subnets but target new Privatelink endpoints; extended the installer Helm chart with a new 'switchover-operator' deployment implementing a staged switchover finite-state-machine (drain, probe, swap-routes, update-dns, rotate-sgs); added preflight and postflight checks, canary rollout hooks, and a rollback path that restores previous route tables and DNS records. Also added IAM least-privilege policies for the operator and integration tests for staged swap behavior.

Implementation details: 1) Terraform: new modules/network/shadow_subnet.tf creates duplicate subnets with descriptive tags (redwood:shadow-of=<subnet-id>), a dedicated route table (rtb-shadow-<subnet>) and conditional Privatelink ENI attachments. The module is opt-in via installer values: "enable_subnet_shadowing". 2) Helm: new chart component "switchover-operator" (controllers, rbac, deployment, hpa) with configurable concurrency and probe thresholds. 3) Operator: implements stages (PREPARE -> DRAIN_ROUTES -> PROBE -> SWAP_ROUTES -> UPDATE_DNS -> ROTATE_SGS -> VERIFY -> COMPLETE). Operator uses a leader-elected controller; state stored in a CRD (SwitchoverPlan) scoped to the install namespace. 4) DNS: staged TTL reduction and atomic CNAME swaps for control plane zone to minimize cache inconsistencies. The operator writes DNS intent records during PROBE so monitoring can verify consistency before final swap. 5) Security: new IAM policy documents added to terraform/iam/privatelink_operator_policy.json with only ec2:CreateNetworkInterface, ec2:DescribeRouteTables, route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets (narrowed to control plane hosted zone), and iam:PassRole to a dedicated operator role. 6) Observability: added metrics (switchover_attempts_total, switchover_stage_duration_seconds, switchover_failures_total) and logs annotated with plan_id and subnet_shadow_id.

Rollout and migration plan: create shadow subnets for a single region and AZ, attach test control-plane nodes to shadow route table, enable operator in canary mode (max_concurrent_plans=1) and run a single SwitchoverPlan with dry_run=false and probe_threshold=5 successful probes. After 48 hours of metrics and smoke-testing (control-plane latencies, hello-checks), increase to 50% AZs and finally full cutover. Operator supports pause/resume and immediate rollback which swaps back original RTs and restores DNS and SG attachments.

Testing: unit tests for operator state transitions added under operator/pkg/*; integration tests in infra/tests/switchover/ exercise per-AZ swap and rollback using a local k8s kind cluster with a mocked AWS API (moto-based harness). Added end-to-end acceptance that validates DNS TTL behavior and confirms no dropped control-plane requests during probe thresholds. CI: full workflow includes lint, unit, integration (mocked), and a lightweight k8s smoke test. One flaky network test was stabilized by adding retry backoff (see commits).

Backward compatibility and safety: feature is opt-in and default off. Existing clusters are unaffected unless enable_subnet_shadowing is set. The operator verifies sanity (route table tags, ENI attachment health, DNS ownership) before performing modifying actions. Rollback is idempotent and safe to run multiple times.

Related work: follows patterns in ENG-2124 (safe egress transition) and Infra ticket INF-398 (Privatelink orchestration). This PR is intended to reduce blast radius when migrating endpoints and to give SREs an automated, observable path for rolling upgrades.

Files touched and high-level diffs included in the commits. See changed_files for specifics.

release_notes: Add opt-in subnet shadowing feature to enable non-destructive Privatelink migrations.
New switchover-operator Helm chart for staged per-AZ cutovers with safe rollback.
New observability metrics and runbook for Privatelink endpoint migration.
